basis: Warn-only first cut derived from the three counted five-run sessions on the canonical iPhone 17 Pro (IUI-2 baseline 2026-08-12, IUI-4 wave-1 after 2026-08-13, IUI-5 wave-2 after 2026-08-15; tables in docs/reference/ios-ui-refresh-2026-08.md): hitch ceilings sit ~1.5-2x the worst session median and gap ceilings ~2x the worst clean observation, tightened where the P4 keep-alive regression (IUI-5 part-1 bisect) must breach (tab-navigation 119-155 ms/s and voices-scroll 115-118 ms/s both warn). Warn-only: a breach marks the scenario and run passedWithWarnings and never blocks publication; promotion to hard ceilings requires repeated baseline sessions showing stable spread (macOS UI-7 precedent). Exploratory scenarios (ios-player-scrub, ios-generation-active) carry no ceilings by design.
